LanguageData.MS_Transport_OpenDesc: Transfer items between the storage network and this material supplier in either direction.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_CapacityRule: Mass limit: {0} kg (set when this window opens)
LanguageData.MS_Transport_Available: Available from the network: {0}. Items reserved by other tasks cannot be transferred.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_SupplyTip: Items currently in the supplier and the quantity after confirmation.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_QuantityTip: Positive quantities load the supplier; negative quantities return items to the network. Arrows adjust quantities; double arrows transfer all items in that direction. >M fills this item's quantity up to the mass limit, accounting for existing cargo and other selections; the double arrow returns at the limit. Hold the left mouse button and drag across arrow buttons to adjust multiple rows, once per row per drag.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_Mass: Supplier mass: {0} → {1} kg Limit: {2} kg (including selections hidden by filters)
LanguageData.MS_Transport_Overweight: The supplier would exceed its mass limit. Reduce incoming quantities or return some items to the network before confirming.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_Hint: Confirm executes all selections; cancel moves nothing. The supplier delivers to the transporter or refuelable building directly ahead at the configured refresh interval. Excess or incompatible items stay in the supplier.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_Unavailable: Items or network status changed, and the full transfer could not be completed. The list has been refreshed. Check both inventories before retrying.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_ReturnFilterRejected: Some returning items are not allowed by the storage core's filter. This transfer was cancelled.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_ReturnCapacityInsufficient: The storage network does not have enough remaining capacity to accept all returning items. This transfer was cancelled.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_Refreshed: The network or inventory changed. The list was refreshed and transfer quantities were reset.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_NoTarget: No transporter or refuelable building directly ahead; waiting to supply.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_SwitchModeDesc: Switch between manual storage and continuous supply. Empty the supplier's own contents before switching.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_ModeBlocked: Empty this material supplier's own contents first.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_DirectHint: Select up to three item types to send directly from the network at the configured refresh interval. The supplier stores nothing. Higher rows have priority; unavailable or incompatible items are skipped. Items reserved by other tasks are excluded.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_PickHint: Select one item type per slot. Higher slots are supplied first; duplicate selections are not allowed.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_ImmediateDesc: Immediately supply the target directly ahead.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_GenericSupplyDesc: Improves compatibility, but does not guarantee that the target mod will recognize the inserted items.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_ChooseContainerDesc: Select a container exposed by the player-owned building directly ahead. A single container is used automatically; choose a target when several are available. Transporters and refuelable buildings take priority and use their dedicated supply rules.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_NoGenericTarget: No transporter, refuelable building or generic container available directly ahead; waiting to supply.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_SelectContainerFirst: The target has multiple containers. Select a target container first.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_SpecializedTarget: This target uses dedicated transporter or fuel supply rules.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_ImmediateEmpty: The material supplier has no items to supply.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_CreateGroupDesc: Create a launch group from the {0} selected transport pods, keeping their contents. Material suppliers and launch checks share the group's total mass capacity; individual pods may exceed their own capacity. Use the standard launch command after grouping.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_GroupAlreadyAssigned: A selected transport pod already belongs to a launch group. Select only ungrouped pods.
LanguageData.MS_Transport_GroupInvalid: Select ungrouped player-owned transport pods of the same type on the same map.
